tweets: Ram Setu — Adam's Bridge: a 48-km chain of limestone shoals linking Rāmeśvaram to Mannar Island, Sri Lanka. The Rāmāyaṇa remembers it as Setubandhanam, the crossing raised by Rāma's Vānara army under engineers Nala and Nīla to reach Laṅkā.

NASA's 2002 orbital photograph first revealed this ancient line of shoals clearly from space — a stretch of sacred geography, long sung in verse, now also read in satellite light. Follow @yddoseOfHistory for your daily dose of history
